source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Hello, I am 28 years old and I work as a sales consultant. I am a university graduate. I love traveling places and going to theaters, I play a lot of games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: I also play action games like Call of Duty, but it does not replace Pubg.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: I like it more because it's exciting. If we give car racing games as an example, what you do is to go left and right, but there are tasks in shooter games. We are in a constant adventure and we are fighting in these games, it is more attractive because we men like to fight in these games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: I've heard of it but never experienced it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Does GTA 4 and 5 count as shooter games?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Sometimes I am seeking a duel, I usually play with my friends, but sometimes I play with random people.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: I'm usually the team leader. They sacrifice me, they usually send me ahead in the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: There are times when I play competitively.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: These kinds of things in the game show that you are good at the game and not an amateur. Having a high rank indicates that you are experienced.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Sometimes when I get bored of playing normally, I play rank matches, I think it makes the game more fun and competitive.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: When I first started the game, the gun was accidentally bouncing while aiming. I couldn't hit the place I was aiming for. Later on, I started to aim better by using the training room inside Pubg. After that, as I practiced, I started to aim better. I'm aiming very well now.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: I usually use two fingers.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: I don't use anything like that, but there is something that is put on the finger and prevents the finger from sweating. I use that.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: I look at the games that come on Instagram, I also look at the games that are at the top of the lists, there is a technology page, and I also look at the games published there.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: ShiftDelete and Webtekno. In these pages, sometimes news is published when expensive games are free, and I follow those news.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: The game is action-packed and enjoyable, there are different modes, there are a lot of weapons in the game, we can choose a lot of weapons. It's nice to have different options. These are crucial to me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: After all, this is a war game, it is very important for me to have different maps, I get bored when I play on the same map all the time, it is also very important to have different weapons, and it is very nice to have different clothes in the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Escape From Tarkov seems familiar but I don’t know it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: I think this one was a version of Call of Duty.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: I played a version of it but not 2042 I guess.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Both are action-packed war games. Both require aiming.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Yes, because this game genre is action-packed and fun. For example, this genre interests me more than racing games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: The fact that there are many weapon options, the number of maps is high, the game is popular, we can find a lot of people to play when the game is crowded, these are very important.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: My friends also like this kind of games. They also play Pubg Metro Royale. They also like action-packed games like me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: I have friends who don't play because usually they don't have time or they play other games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: They usually play because they're married or because they're bored.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Advertisements for the game were constantly appearing in front of me and I had a lot of friends playing. Usually when I was chatting with my friends, they were constantly talking to me about this game and asking why I didn't download it. I was curious about the game, I downloaded it thanks to their advice and we started playing together. Of course, there is also the effect of advertisements. On Instagram or any social media platform, the game was constantly appearing before me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: I assumed the game was of good quality since the game is very popular and everyone downloads and plays it. For example, when I was a kid, everyone was playing GTA Vice City, this game was so popular. I thought it would be good if it was this popular. I thought it was a more digital and more modern game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Yes, it met my expectations, the game has a lot of modes made with the latest technology, the graphics are very realistic, not like other games, I really felt like I was on a street.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Because there are more maps, more stages, it is possible to equip weapons, there are more active players. It seems to me like it is a mode played by more experienced players.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Considering that I play 3 hours a day and play every day, I have quite a bit of game time.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: We usually play as a team. I get bored playing alone.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Because the number of stages is more, the number of weapons is more and the number of active players is high.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: In general, the number of active players is less and there are less experienced players, and it seems to me that the number of weapons and outfits is less.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: When I first started, I played Battle Royale mode for 1-2 weeks, then I started playing Metro Royale.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: In general, compared to other games, weapons have less recoil. I think the scopes are nicer and the weapons are more interesting. At the same time, there are more stages.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: For example, I played Call of Duty before, but these features were not there.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: As I said, the number of active players is high and the people are experienced.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: There are more outfits in this version, even if the opponents are logging into the game with the computer, the game mode is more difficult.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: When I first started the game, because I was a beginner, I was dying very quickly and I was not enjoying this game. Afterwards, as I got used to the game and played better, I started to enjoy the game more.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: I started to play better, I learned what I did not know in the game, where the enemy would come from, what weapons I should use. Whether my choice of clothing is important to allow camouflage. I learned all this over time.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Pubg is more enjoyable, the guns don't recoil much when I aim. There is no such thing in Call of Duty, and the scopes are not very good in Call of Duty. Even if we aim directly at the opponent, the man may not die. Call of Duty is a bit more like a military game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: There are more military outfits in COD, the game reminds me of Afghanistan, but it's too complicated, unrealistic and obviously artificial.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: The game seems more realistic to me compared to other games, it’s fun to play the game, the choice of weapons is more, the number of players is more. It is more enjoyable in general, more enjoyable than Call of Duty.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: We don't have a chance to make money in the game, I wish it was.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: For example, I am coming from the office, there is traffic on the road, I play Pubg so that I will not be bored when I am in traffic, or I play when I am bored after dinner at home.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: I'm trying to finish first in the team and I'm trying to survive the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Of course, it's important to be first and be popular with the players, so that others see you and wonder who you are.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: It's actually not that important to me, it might be fun if I'm first in the rankings, but I don't care too much about this.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: As I said, I was a beginner before. I didn't enjoy the game much. As I learned the features of the game, I started to enjoy it more.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: For example, dying early. When I die early, if my teammates are alive, I have to wait until the game is over.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: It's not that important, but it just causes a waste of time. Actually, it may be better to increase the HP of the character in the game. Or if the bags in the game were bigger, it would be better if we could take more med kits with us.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: The fact that the game is new and new updates are constantly coming to the game, there are no problems such as lag in the game, we can drop from the game in other games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Yes, there is no such thing as drop out of the game, in fact, it would be very nice if an agreement is reached with the operators to solve the internet problem. For example, there is a private internet for the game and I only use that internet while playing Pubg, this can be very nice.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Yes it has more potential compared to other games. Yes, there are more weapon options, we can hit the target directly when we aim, and it does not recoil. The number of scopes is high, we can use the scope we want. We have more options.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Of course, scopes are important so that I can clearly see what I am aiming at. It is also important that the weapon’s bullet capacity is high.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: It is important to kill the opponent, sometimes the opponent may not die with 1 or 2 bullets. I want to be able to fire 30 or 40 bullets at once. The opponent dies with 5 already, but with more bullets I have more luck.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: I think this is a good thing, improving ourselves makes the game more enjoyable.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Yes, because we will aim better, we will buy better things, we improve ourselves, these are always enjoyable things in the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Yes. We set a goal and to achieve this goal, we play more games to improve ourselves. We come to the goal we set by moving forward, this is a good thing, it would be very boring if there is no goal in the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: To be a good player and to reach higher levels.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Yes, we have more freedom, we have more weapon options. Also, the graphics do not tire the eyes. Sometimes you may even need to wear glasses to play games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: There are generally military clothes in Call of Duty, as if we are in the military, there are no different clothes. There is no such situation in Pubg, there are different clothes, I can wear whatever I want, this is a freedom for me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: It is a freedom to have more weapon options and to be able to play with different weapons.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: I think so, the difference between a beginner player and a master player is that master players can use more difficult weapons.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Yes, it can make me feel like we're in this game, like the Metaverse, that I'm really hurt and just stitching up. And that would be advantageous because as I said, it's nice that even the streets feel like they're real streets. For example, if the game comes with an Istanbul map, I would be happy to see the streets of Istanbul in the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: I can actually rank it exactly as you said.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Being able to choose the weapon I want and the outfit I want is more important to me. No matter how realistic the game is, if I always wear same outfit and use same weapons, I get bored.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Because freedom is more attractive, no matter how realistic the game is, if it has two weapons and three clothes, I think it will be boring and formal. I think it is more important to have civilian clothes rather than military clothes.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: What fantasy themes, like monsters?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: It would be like Jurassic Park, there was a game mode where dinosaurs appeared in Pubg before, it would be like that.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: It takes away the realism of the game, I think it makes it more childish. It takes the game in a different direction, I think I liked Pubg that way, I didn't like it with dinosaurs.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Yes. If I wanted to play fantasy games, I would go and choose such a game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Will this character fight with magic, not with weapons?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: It might be good if they offer it as an option, others may not want it if it's mandatory in the game. For example, I should be able to be a wizard while I am fighting, but I do not want a wizard to appear while I am playing a game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: First of all, I don't want the game to have problems such as drop, lag and FPS. The game should be up to date and not take up too much storage space on the phone. The game should not use too much internet data. In the game, there should be a lot of clothing and weapon options, the game should be realistic. The game design should be good.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: No, not that much. Maybe there is an elevator.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: If I had to give an example of GTA 4, that game was very realistic, the avatar in the game was like real, I was really like in San Francisco. Such a reality can be good.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: The avatar in the game should be realistic, I think it should look like a human.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Getting sick, going to the hospital, waiting in the hospital and having the nurse stitch the wound, I think these would be too detailed. Not that much detail...

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: There may be things like stitching one's own when injured, not like a hospital. Things that might be realistic but not exaggerated can be put into game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: For example, cars are not very realistic.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: At least I want the image to look like a real car when we look at cars they don't really look like cars.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: During an accident, things like airbags can be added.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: I think it is appropriate. For example, we may want to buy clothes, we may want to differentiate our appearance.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Earning money can make the game very enjoyable but it depends on how you earn it. Are you talking about someone buying a gun from me and making money?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: It can be nice if we make money in real life. For example, in a team game, things like winning 100 TL can be good.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Yes, it can be like this, or you can earn money in the game and buy weapons with it. It's like playing a game with friends and the loser paying the bill.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: I'm not against doing this. Anyone can buy what they want.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: I don't have any reaction to this issue, from time to time I buy weapons and clothes to strengthen myself. It is important to me that the payment options are secure.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: If the price will be affordable, boxes that can contain random items can be very nice.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Yes, it is an upgraded version of BR.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: After all, it is a game inside Pubg, this is not a different game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: There's just more weapon and clothing options, that's all.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: Yes, just variety. The only feature is to have a stronger avatar with more important weapons, better aiming makes the game more enjoyable.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D3-英文原版
text: I mean, it didn't give me that much pleasure because it's a military-style game anyway. Pubg gives me more pleasure.
